company.name: Superunit
company.shortDescription: AI agents for faster, more cost effective employment verifications
company.description: Superunit provides employment and background verification services using automated voice and email agents. It contacts employers through phone, email, or fax to confirm employment and income, and records interactions with transcripts.

productsAndServices.description: Automates employment and income verifications using AI agents that contact employers via phone, email, or fax to reduce manual work and turnaround times.
productsAndServices.name: AI-Powered Employment & Income Verifications

productsAndServices.description: Provides various verification types including employment, income, reference, DOT, education, court records, and lab/clinic follow-ups.
productsAndServices.name: Comprehensive Verification Services

productsAndServices.description: Conducts extensive contact research with access to nearly every active employer in the US and 100 million businesses worldwide to support verifications.
productsAndServices.name: Contact Research Capabilities

productsAndServices.description: Delivers verification results directly to client systems via API for real-time data access and workflow automation.
productsAndServices.name: API Integration for Verification Data

productsAndServices.description: Uses AI agents to perform unlimited simultaneous outbound calls and emails for verifications without limits on attempts.
productsAndServices.name: AI Agents for Unrestricted Outreach

productsAndServices.description: Automates bill of materials, standard costing, and variance analysis by connecting ERP, PDFs, and spreadsheets for cost accounting.
productsAndServices.name: AI Cost Accounting for Manufacturers & Retailers

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $5,583,227 to $7,086,248, a 1.27x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 81 (-4 over 90 days) and market heat at 82 (+0).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.

insights.title: Competitive benchmark reflects the modeled peer set
